articles.title: Weird Al Yankovic Now Has an Asteroid Named After Him
articles.summary: Singer Weird Al Yankovic just got an asteroid named in his honor. Asteroid (14331) Alyankovic is about 1 to 1.25 miles wide and orbits between Mars and Jupiter.

articles.title: This Robot Rolls Up Like an Armadillo to Protect Itself
articles.summary: Engineers built a soft robot that curls into a ball like an armadillo. When touched, it rolls up in about a minute to protect fragile electronics inside.

articles.title: A Dead Star Is Making a Shock Wave That Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: Astronomers found a dead star creating a huge shock wave in space. Based on what we know, it shouldn't be possible. The discovery could change how we understand stars.
